verbalization: Quinolinic acid is implicated in the pathogenesis of neurological disorders, and its interaction with the Ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase family member 6 (ENPP6) appears to be mediated through a cascade of enzymatic activities. The evidence suggests that Quinolinic Acid acts as a target of a specific enzyme, Isopentenyl-diphosphate Delta-isomerase, which in turn targets ENPP6. This implies a potential regulatory pathway where Quinolinic Acid may influence ENPP6 activity through the intermediate of Isopentenyl-diphosphate Delta-isomerase. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Quinolinic Acid in modulating ENPP6 function, potentially through the enzymatic activity of Isopentenyl-diphosphate Delta-isomerase. The observed scores and the sequential targeting suggest a mechanistic link that could be further explored to understand the broader implications of this relationship in disease processes.
